The following metrics apply to the OTel trace source. Each metric is
preﬁxed by the sub-pipeline name and otel_trace_source. For example,
sub_pipeline_name.otel_trace_source.requestTimeouts.count.
Metric suﬃx
Description
requestTimeouts.count
The number of requests that timed out.
Relevant statistics: Sum
Dimension: PipelineName
requestsReceived.count
The number of requests received by the plugin.
Monitoring pipeline metrics

Metric suﬃx
Description
Relevant statistics: Sum
Dimension: PipelineName
successRequests.count
The number of requests that were successfully processed
by the plugin.
Relevant statistics: Sum
Dimension: PipelineName
badRequests.count
The number of requests with an invalid format that were
processed by the plugin.
Relevant statistics: Sum
Dimension: PipelineName
requestsTooLarge.count
The number of requests of which the number of spans in
the content is larger than the buﬀer capacity.
Relevant statistics: Sum
Dimension: PipelineName
internalServerError.count
The number of requests processed by the plugin with a
custom exception type.
Relevant statistics: Sum
Dimension: PipelineName
requestProcessDura
tion.count
A count of data points recorded while processing requests
by the plugin.
Relevant statistics: Sum
Dimension: PipelineName
